summary: Master RPO strategies with our comprehensive training course. Enhance your recruitment skills and streamline your hiring process for better results.
lede: Recruitment process outsourcing training helps talent acquisition, RPO, recruitment operations, and HR procurement professionals govern outsourced hiring. They learn to map service scope and handoffs, assess recruitment funnel and ATS data, and build supplier scorecards with service levels and performance measures. Exercises apply these methods to provider reviews, risk controls, and transition planning, including governance for AI-assisted sourcing and candidate data.
audienceIntro: Recruitment Process Outsourcing training suits professionals who influence outsourced hiring delivery, supplier governance, recruitment technology, or workforce planning. It is designed for intermediate practitioners who already work with recruitment processes and need stronger commercial, operational, and analytical control.
prerequisites: You should have working knowledge of recruitment or talent acquisition processes, including requisition intake, sourcing, screening, interviews, and hiring decisions. Experience with an applicant tracking system, recruitment supplier, or procurement process will help, but you do not need prior RPO contract ownership. No coding or programming is required. Advanced recruitment technology and AI-assisted sourcing topics are taught at operational application level, not technical engineering level.
